description: Baked-in two-intensity refresh (Cmd+R / Cmd+Shift+R analog). Fires BOTH `refresh_faf` + `refresh_fafm` in one call. `mode: "blend"` (default) = light `.faf` + delta `.fafm` — the everyday re-ground. `mode: "nuke"` = light `.faf` + verbatim `.fafm` — the hard reload for polluted session memory. Intensity matches drift rate per layer.

baseline.description: For refresh_faf: your last-known score (0-100). Drift delta reported if provided.

path.description: For refresh_faf: project directory or .faf path (supports ~).

since.description: For refresh_fafm (delta mode only): ISO timestamp. Only facts modified after this. Ignored when mode=nuke (verbatim).

soul.description: For refresh_fafm: specific soul. Omit or 'default' for primary; 'all' for every soul.

name: refresh_blend
